# Blockly UI media

Copied unchanged from the `blockly` npm dependency (13.2.1),
https://github.com/RaspberryPiFoundation/blockly/tree/blockly-v13.2.1/media.
Blockly is licensed under Apache-2.0; see LICENSE.txt.
These are interface icons and cursors, not generated illustrations.

Regenerate the JavaScript bundle and these assets with `npm run build:blockly`.
Sound files are omitted because this workbench disables Blockly sounds.
